business_summary: Zhuhai Enpower Electric Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of power electronic components in China and internationally. It also manufactures and sells automotive parts and accessories, and electrical accessories for new energy vehicles; manufacture of electric motor; develops and sells software; retails and wholesale computer hardware, software, and auxiliary equipment; and repairs electrical equipment. The company was founded in 2005 and is based in Zhuhai, China.
